title: TRIA ROXAS AI analysis metadata schema
description: Schema for ROXAS AI-specific analysis metadata for a TRIA dataset

outmost_year.title: Outmost year
outmost_year.description: Calendar year of the outermost complete ring. SH: year in which the growth began

cluster_dbl_cwt_threshold.title: Double cwt threshold
cluster_dbl_cwt_threshold.description: Threshold for detecting cell wall clusters [µm]

relwidth_cwt_integration.title: Rel width of cwt integration
relwidth_cwt_integration.description: Relative width along cell wall for cwt estimation

lower_limit_cwt_iqr_multiplier.title: Lower cwt IQR multiplier
lower_limit_cwt_iqr_multiplier.description: Lower IQR multiplier to identify cwt outliers

upper_limit_cwt_iqr_multiplier.title: Upper cwt IQR multiplier
upper_limit_cwt_iqr_multiplier.description: Upper IQR multiplier to identify cwt outliers

opposite_cwt_ratio_limit.title: Max ratio of opposing cwt
opposite_cwt_ratio_limit.description: Max ratio of the cwt of opposing walls

adjacent_cwt_ratio_limit.title: Max ratio of adjacent cwt
adjacent_cwt_ratio_limit.description: Max ratio of the cwt of adjacent walls

reference_series.title: RW reference series
reference_series.description: Label of the ring width series used as dating reference
